questions.text:
In what ratio must a grocer mix two varieties of rice worth ₹49 per kg and ₹119 per kg so that if he
sells the mixture at ₹144 per kg he may gain 60%?

A, B and C started a business with their investment in the ratio of 2 : 3 : 4. Find the difference
between the share of B and share of C from the total annual profit of ₹46,800.

Let C be a circle with centre O and PQ be an arc on C which is 10 cm long. If the circumference of
the circle is 120 cm, find the angle made by the arc PQ at O.

The present cost of a plot area is ₹1,51,726. After a year, its cost increased to ₹1,96,537. The
percentage increase (rounded off to the nearest integer) in the cost of the plot area is:
Simplify: (2⁵ × 4³) / (8² × 2³).

In a competitive examination, Ramu scores 86 marks in Mathematics and 78 marks in Statistics,
each out of 100. If the weight assigned to Mathematics is 1 and the weight assigned to Statistics is 3,
then what is Ramu’s weighted average score?

A boat takes 3 hours to travel 24 km downstream and 8 hours to travel 16 km upstream. What is
the speed (in km/h) of the stream?

The volume of a cuboid is 3150 cm³. Its length is 28 cm and breadth is 15 cm. Find its height (in
cm).

Three numbers x, y, and z are such that x : y = 2 : 5, y : z = 6 : 7 and x + y + z = 308. What is the
fourth proportional of these three numbers?
If 20% of 20 − (4/5) × ∛343 × √25 = y, then the value of y is:

The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 18 and 378 respectively. If one of the numbers is 54, find
the other number.
If x² − 5x + 1 = 0, find the value of x³ + 1/x³.

A shopkeeper bought 80 kg of sugar at ₹40 per kg and 120 kg of sugar at ₹50 per kg. At what
price per kg should he sell the mixture to gain 25%?

A sum of money at simple interest amounts to ₹1,012 in 2.5 years and to ₹1,067.20 in 4 years. Find
the rate of interest per annum.

The compound interest on a sum of money for 2 years is ₹832 and the simple interest on the
same sum for the same period is ₹800. Find the difference between CI and SI for 3 years.

A man covers a certain distance by car at 60 km/h and returns on a scooter at 40 km/h. Find his
average speed for the entire journey.

A train 150 m long passes a man walking at 6 km/h in the same direction in 10 seconds. Find the
speed of the train.

A, B, and C can complete a work in 20, 24, and 30 days respectively. All three started together,
but A left after 4 days and B left 6 days before completion of the work. In how many days was the total
work completed?

Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 15 hours and 20 hours respectively, while a third pipe C can
empty it in 25 hours. All three pipes are opened in the beginning. After 10 hours, C is closed. In how
much time will the tank be full?

The population of a town increases by 10% in the first year and decreases by 10% in the second
year. If the present population is 49,500, what was the population 2 years ago?

The ratio of the ages of Meena and her mother is 3 : 8. After 6 years, the ratio of their ages will
be 4 : 9. What is Meena’s present age?
If sin A = 5/13 and A is an acute angle, find the value of (tan A + sec A).
Find the 15th term of the arithmetic progression: 7, 13, 19, 25, ...

A bag contains 6 black and 8 white balls. One ball is drawn at random. What is the probability
that the ball drawn is white?
In how many ways can 5 boys and 3 girls be seated in a row so that no two girls sit together?

A dishonest dealer professes to sell his goods at cost price, but uses a weight of 800 grams
instead of 1 kg. Find his gain percentage.
If a : b = 3 : 4 and b : c = 5 : 7, find (a + b) : (b + c).

The average of 8 numbers is 24. If each number is multiplied by 3 and then 4 is added to each,
what is the new average?
What is the unit digit of (4387)²⁴⁵ × (621)⁷²?
If α and β are the roots of x² − 6x + 8 = 0, find the value of α³ + β³.
A conical tent is 10 m high and the radius of its base is 24 m. Find the slant height of the tent.
Two numbers are in the ratio 4 : 5 and their LCM is 180. Find the smaller number.

A man spends 75% of his income. His income increases by 20% and his expenditure increases by
10%. Find the percentage increase in his savings.
If 3^(x − y) = 27 and 3^(x + y) = 243, find the value of x.

A and B can do a piece of work in 10 days and 15 days respectively. They work together for 4
days, after which B leaves. In how many more days will A finish the remaining work?

What is the total export revenue (in ₹ Crore) from Electronics and Automobiles together?
What is the central angle corresponding to Textiles and Chemicals together?
By what percent is the export revenue of Pharma more than that of Automobiles?
What is the average electricity consumption (in kWh) of all five households in April?
Which household had the lowest total electricity consumption across all four months?

What is the percentage increase in total electricity consumption of all five households from
February to April?

Each of S, T, U, V, W, X and Y has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and
ending on Sunday. S has an exam on Wednesday. Only one person has exam between S and T. U has
exam on the day immediately before T but not on a Monday. Only two people have exams between U
and V. W’s exam is on one of the days before X but on one of the days after Y. V’s exam is not on
Sunday. On which day does W have the exam?

C, D, E, F, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. K sits third to the left of
F. J sits second to the left of L. F is an immediate neighbour of both D and J. E is not an immediate
neighbour of K. How many people sit between C and J when counted from the right of C?

If ‘A’ stands for ‘+’, ‘B’ stands for ‘−’, ‘C’ stands for ‘×’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘÷’, then what will come in
place of the question mark (?) in: 25 A 18 D 6 C 3 B 9 = ?

If 1 is subtracted from each odd digit and 2 is subtracted from each even digit in the number
635798368345, what will be the sum of the digits which are third from the left and second from the
right in the new number thus formed?

In a certain code language, ‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’, ‘A − B’ means ‘A is the brother of
B’, ‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’, ‘A % B’ means ‘A is the father of B’ and ‘A # B’ means ‘A is the
daughter of B’. How is G related to L if ‘G − C + K # N % L’?

What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English
alphabetical order? SIK, XNP, CSU, HXZ, ?

DG15 is related to IL17 in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way,
TA19 is related to YF21. To which of the given options is CP24 related, following the same logic?

Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and
ending on Sunday. U has an exam on Friday. Only 2 people have an exam between U and R. V has an
exam immediately before P and Q has an exam immediately after S. Only 2 people have an exam
between T and P. How many people have exams after V?

If 1 is added to each odd digit and 2 is subtracted from each even digit in the number 47542386,
then what will be the sum of the digits that are second from the left and fourth from the right in the
new number thus formed?

code?

Five friends A, B, C, D, and E sit on a bench facing North. A is next to B, C is next to D, D is not
sitting with E who is on the left end of the bench. C is in the second position from the right. A is to the
right of B and E. A and C are sitting together. In which position is A sitting?
If 1st January 2026 is a Thursday, what day of the week will 31st December 2026 be?
How many times do the hands of a clock coincide in a 24-hour day?
In a row of 60 students, Rahul is 24th from the left. What is his rank from the right?

If ‘÷’ means ‘+’, ‘−’ means ‘÷’, ‘×’ means ‘−’, and ‘+’ means ‘×’, find the value of: (36 × 4) − 8 × 4 ÷ 4
+ 8 × 2.
Arrange the following in a logical order: 1. Country 2. Furniture 3. Forest 4. Wood 5. Trees

How many meaningful 4-letter English words can be formed using the 1st, 2nd, 5th, and 8th
letters of the word ‘MASTERING’ (each used once)?
If ‘ACE’ is coded as ‘9’ and ‘BAD’ is coded as ‘7’, what is the code for ‘FACE’?
Find the next term in the series: Z2A, X4D, V8G, T16J, ?

Six persons P, Q, R, S, T, and U have different heights. P is taller than only two persons. Q is
shorter than S but taller than R. T is taller than S. U is shorter than P. Who is the tallest?

A lady pointed to a boy and said, “He is the son of my husband’s father’s only daughter-in-law.” If
her husband has no brother, how is the boy related to the lady?
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the equation correct? 28 ÷ 7 + 5 × 4 − 10 = 14

In a certain code, ‘256’ means ‘you are good’, ‘637’ means ‘we are bad’, and ‘358’ means ‘good
and bad’. Which digit stands for ‘and’?
A watch reads 4:30. If the minute hand points East, in which direction will the hour hand point?
If ‘TIGER’ is coded as ‘UJHFS’, how is ‘ZEBRA’ coded?

Six friends A, B, C, D, E, and F sit around a circular table facing the centre. B sits between F and
C. A sits between E and D. F sits to the immediate left of D. Who sits between A and F?

In a class, 30 students play Cricket, 25 play Football, and 10 play both. If every student plays at
least one game, how many students are in the class?

A man walks 5 km South, then turns right and walks 3 km, then turns left and walks 5 km. In
which direction is he from the starting point?

A cube of side 5 cm is painted green on all faces and cut into 1 cm cubes. How many smaller
cubes have ONLY ONE face painted?
